_readme: Orion OS App Catalog — apps a user can install. Separate from installed apps (localStorage) and built-in apps (apps.json). Static for now; the loader (registry.loadCatalog) is structured so this could later come from a remote endpoint. Entry fields: id, name, description, type, runtime (direct|embed|external), target, iconUrl?, version, category?, publisher?. Use only sites appropriate for embedding; direct entries must permit framing, otherwise use external.
